title: X quietly limits users who didn't pay for verification to "50 original posts and 200 replies per day", down from 2,400 posts per day (Jackson Chen/Engadget)
summary: Jackson Chen / Engadget: X quietly limits users who didn't pay for verification to “50 original posts and 200 replies per day”, down from 2,400 posts per day — That's down from the previous 2,400 posts per day limit. — X has introduced some more incentive to get users to pay for “verification” …
contentText:
Jackson Chen / Engadget :

X quietly limits users who didn't pay for verification to “50 original posts and 200 replies per day”, down from 2,400 posts per day   —  That's down from the previous 2,400 posts per day limit.  —  X has introduced some more incentive to get users to pay for “verification” …
